## [0.2.10] - 2026-10-21

### Security

- **Chrome is pinned to 155.0.8059.79 (puppeteer 25.14.0 and its base image move with it).** The new base image ships 155.0.8059.79, and the Dockerfile refuses to build when the newest Chrome in the image is not the pin, so the pin moves with it. The pin, the base image and the `puppeteer` npm package are bumped together.
- **`express` 5.3.0 and `postcss` 8.5.30** (minor/patch updates of the service's two direct runtime dependencies, with the transitive `content-type` and related packages that came with them).

### Fixed

- **A `vbscript:` URL is never used as a page's document base.** `<base href>` already ignored `data:` and `javascript:` values; `vbscript:` is now treated the same. There was no reachable impact (such a base has an opaque path, relative links cannot resolve against it, and only http(s) is ever fetched); this closes the CodeQL `js/incomplete-url-scheme` finding.

### Deploy

- Container image: `ghcr.io/solarssk/wp-critical-css:0.2.10` (rolling `:latest`, `:0.2`), also published to `docker.io/solarssk/wp-critical-css:0.2.10`.
- WordPress plugin: `wp-critical-css-0.2.10.zip`, attached to this release. The plugin itself is unchanged; its version moves only to stay in lockstep with the service.
- No migration steps and no new setting. Pull the new image and restart.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/solarssk/wp-critical-css/blob/v0.2.10/CHANGELOG.md)
